# Third-Party Components

This directory records third-party material used by this repository, its
licences, and any notices those licences require.

## Inventory

This repository contains no third-party code, bundled third-party material or
build dependencies.

## Policy

Third-party material in AnvayaOS repositories must be under a licence that is
compatible with distributing the project under Apache-2.0 OR MIT.

- Permissive licences are accepted: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, Zlib,
  Unlicense, BlueOak-1.0.0 and Unicode-3.0.
- Bundled fonts may use the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
- Copyleft licences (GPL, LGPL, AGPL, MPL) need the maintainer's approval
  before anything under them is added.

When you add third-party material:

1. Add it to the inventory below, with its version and licence.
2. If the material itself is committed to this repository, put its licence
   text in this directory.
3. If its licence requires a notice, add that notice to `../NOTICE`.
